name: Action Auto Parts
old_description: Providing you, our customer, with excellent service for over 40 years!
about:
Action Auto Parts operates as an authorized warehouse distributor of automotive parts and supplies from two locations in Providence, Rhode Island. The company has served the region for over 40 years, building a reputation as a top distributor of auto parts in the state. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The business stocks parts for both foreign and domestic vehicles and runs a dedicated battery division, State Battery Warehouse, which supplies everything from key-fob and AA batteries to new and used automotive batteries and electric forklift batteries. A staff of over 100 includes ASE-certified parts specialists with an average tenure exceeding ten years. Operations are supported by an electronic cataloging and inventory management system, and delivery drivers are GPS-tracked to enable same-day service across the Providence area.

Customers range from independent repair shops and fleet operators to walk-in retail buyers. The company emphasizes accurate parts identification and warrants that its product warranties meet or exceed the original manufacturers' guidelines.

Action Auto Parts was founded on a commitment to customer service, aiming to provide the right part at the right price with rapid fulfillment. Its differentiators include same-day delivery, a deep bench of certified counter personnel, and a technology-driven inventory system that tracks purchases and returns in detail.
